dedupe_keys.name: co udlabs ta ikt 04 test standard development for stormwater management in sweden

description: Johansen, Ann at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden publishes measurements from testing prefabricated stormwater-treatment facilities through Co-UDlabs. RISE, Luleå University, Uponor and IKT investigate performance at the IKT hydraulic test stand to support a proposed Swedish standard. A measuring-data archive confirms an actual deposited collection despite future-tense wording about standard adoption. Coverage is IKT controlled tests in Germany for Swedish stormwater applications; test dates are unspecified. Zenodo provides a measuring-data ZIP archive with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the source does not enumerate the tested products, measured variables or prove that the proposed standard was adopted. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
